showcase: Lets the agent search and read Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Bilibili, X and Reddit through your own logged-in Chrome, with confirmation prompts for actions that change account state.
summary: Config-only DSH bundle that launches the separate PyPI package ai-browser-mcp through uvx as an MCP server. That server drives the user's real Chrome via an extension to search and read logged-in sites.
